ipxact:addressBlock.ipxact:name: smc_top
ipxact:addressBlock.ipxact:description: Top-level SMC address map exposing the resources accessible to external agents.

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: smc_cluster_core0_wdt
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: Watchdog timer configuration, counter, compare, and feed and key registers.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: CTRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: KEY reg must be written to before any other register in this addrmap can be written to, unlocking the WDT. After writing to another register, the WDT will be locked again, and KEY must be written to again to unlock it.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: wdogscale
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: WDT counter scale value. Scales the current cycle count (time) by count / 2 ^ wdogscale value

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: rsvd0
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reserved

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: wdogrsten
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enables a sticky reset signal to outputted to top level, can be used for a second stage wdt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: wdogzerocmp
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable cycle counter to be reset to 0 when compare value has been reached

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: rsvd1
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reserved

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: wdogenalways
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable WDT to always count. This has priority over wdogcoreawake

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: wdogcoreawake
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable WDT to only count when the core is not in reset

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: rsvd2
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reserved

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: wdogip0
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Pending interrupt. Hardware sets this bit on every cycle the scaled count has reached the compare value. To clear it, write KEY and then write 0 to this bit while the scaled count is below the compare value. Writing FEED does not clear it.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: rsvd3
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reserved

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: wdogcount
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: 31 bit wdt counter registers. On write, the counter will be set to the written value, then continue counting up. KEY reg must be written to before any other register in this addrmap can be written to, unlocking the WDT. After writing to another register, the WDT will be locked again, and KEY must be written to again to unlock it.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: wdogs
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Scaled value of wdt counter. (i.e. count >> wdogscale). Writing to this reg has no effect, but will lock the WDT (meaning KEY must be written to KEY reg to unlock it again). KEY reg must be written to before any other register in this addrmap can be written to, unlocking the WDT. After writing to another register, the WDT will be locked again, and KEY must be written to again to unlock it.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: wdogfeed
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Feed register. Writing 0xD09F00D will reset the counter value back to 0. Feeding does not clear CTRL.wdogip0. KEY reg must be written to before any other register in this addrmap can be written to, unlocking the WDT. After writing to another register, the WDT will be locked again, and KEY must be written to again to unlock it.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: wdogkey
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Key register. Magic key (0x51F15E) must be written to this register before a write to any other register in this addrmap. Must be written every time. Reading this reg returns 1 if key has been written to it and it is unlocked, 0 otherwise.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: wdogcmp0
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Compare register. Value that gets compared to wdogs. KEY reg must be written to before any other register in this addrmap can be written to, unlocking the WDT. After writing to another register, the WDT will be locked again, and KEY must be written to again to unlock it.

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: debug_module
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: Memory region through which a hart in Debug Mode exchanges state with the Debug Module: handshake mailboxes, generated instructions, program buffer, data registers, per-hart flags and the debug ROM. Only the harts of the CPU cluster reach this region; SMC bus initiators outside the cluster do not. The debugger-facing Debug Module registers (dmcontrol, dmstatus, abstractcs, sbcs, ...) are reached over the Debug Module Interface and do not appear in this map.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: hartid
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Debug ROM causes the hart to write its hart ID here when it is in Debug Mode.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: hartid
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Debug ROM causes the hart to write 0 here when it begins executing Debug Mode instructions.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: hartid
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Debug ROM causes the hart to write its hart ID here when it leaves Debug Mode.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: hartid
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Debug ROM causes the hart to write 0 here if it takes an exception in Debug Mode.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: instr
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Jump instruction filled in by the Debug Module to direct the hart in Debug Mode.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: instr
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Instruction generated by the Debug Module for the current abstract command.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: data
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Program buffer word shared with the debugger. Byte accesses are supported.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: instr
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Implicit EBREAK instruction following the program buffer.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: data
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Abstract command data word shared with the debugger. Byte accesses are supported.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: FLAGS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: One flag byte per hart, at byte offset equal to the hart ID. Bit 0 is go (execute the command at WHERETO); bit 1 is resume (leave Debug Mode). Bits 7:2 read as 0.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: flags_0
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Hart 0 go/resume flags.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: flags_1
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Hart 1 go/resume flags.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: flags_2
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Hart 2 go/resume flags.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: flags_3
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Hart 3 go/resume flags.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: data
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Debug ROM word. Holds the fixed Debug Mode entry, exception and resume handlers.

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: smc_reset_unit
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: Subsystem reset control, hold and isolation controls, and reset-sequencing status registers.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ss_config
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Configuration registers to setup system configuration. Usage is integration-specific; see the adopter chiplet specification.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: config_lock
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Written to lock down SS config. If bit 0 is written, then bit 0 of other SS config cannot be written to again

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: reset_n_n0_scan
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Subsystem active low cold resets

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: reset_n_n0_scan
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Subsystem active low warm resets

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: configuration_state_hold
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Used with warm_reset_n. Asserting ensures all registers configured during boot, including fuse values for export compliance, SRAM repair, other fuse values, etc. are preserved

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: sram_hold
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Used with warm_reset_n. Asserting ensures SRAMs, latch arrays and anything else that MBIST is used to test and initialize during cold reset are preserved

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: critical_signal_hold
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Used with warm_reset_n. Asserting ensures security, RAS, NMIs, perf counters, debug/trace and other subsystem specific registers are preserved

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: debug_hold
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Used with warm_reset_n. Debug hold signal to ensure any debug registers are preserved

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: reset_complete
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Response signal from subsystem to indicate reset (or some other critical step) has completed. Bitwise write 1 to clear

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: cold_reset_lock
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Written to lock down SS cold reset. If bit 0 is written, then bit 0 of other SS cold reset cannot be written to again

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: force_ss_to_ref_clk_n
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Forces clock to be ref clk. The ensures reset reaches all FFs within a subsystem in same clock cycle

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: sync
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Set to assert global sync bit

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: isolate_req_reg
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Isolate request. This prevents reset from being propagated to SS, keeping them alive in case of a cold reset

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: isolate_req_pinen_reg
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Isolate request pin enable. This enables the external isolate request pin to have an effect on ss isolate requests

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: isolate_req_smc_reg
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Isolate request smc. Asserted once cfg_flr_pf_active is asserted, de-asserted by sw

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: isolate_req_smcen_reg
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Isolate request smc enable. This enables the FLR lock to have an effect on ss isolate requests

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: isolate_req_pin
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Visibility bit for isolate request pin

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: cool_reset_n_i
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Visibility bit for cool reset input

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: cool_reset_n_o
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Visibility bit for cool reset output

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: isolate_req_flr_counter_value
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Number of cycles post cfg_flr_pf_active assertion is waited until cool_reset_n is asserted

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: isolate_req_flr_reset_counter_value
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Number of cycles cool_reset_n is asserted for. NOTE: The cool reset flow requires this value to be greater than 0; a value of 0 will prevent initiation, regardless of ISOLATE_REQ_FLR_COUNTER_VALUE's value

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: smc_misc_wrap
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: Aggregates the SMC scratch, chip-configuration, and NDM-reset register blocks.

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: scratch_cold
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: General-purpose scratch register bank.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: data
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Scratch register

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: scratch_cold_warm
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: General-purpose scratch register bank.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: data
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Scratch register

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: chip_config
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: Chip version, identification, and lifecycle-state registers.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: version_lo
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: SMC version, lower 32 bits

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: version_hi
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: SMC version, upper 32 bits

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: chip_id
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Chip ID (e.g. 0 = Memory, 1 = CPU, 2 = AI Compute, 3 = Ethernet)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: lc_state
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Lifecycle state value from SEP. Default to invalid state

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: ndm_reset
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: Per-cluster NDM reset handshake with an external CPU cluster debug module

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ndmreset_request
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Bit i is the NDM reset request from external CPU cluster i. Bits below ndmreset_cluster_count follow the request input. Bits at and above that count read as 0. The field holds up to 32 clusters.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ndmreset_process
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Bit i is the firmware response to the NDM reset request from external CPU cluster i. Bits below ndmreset_cluster_count are driven on the process output. Bits at and above that count are stored and are not driven. The field holds up to 32 clusters.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ndmreset_cluster_count
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Number of external CPU clusters connected on the low bits of NDMRESET_REQUEST and NDMRESET_PROCESS. Software masks those registers with this value. The maximum is 32.

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: gpio_intf
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: GPIO interface configuration: pad/core routing, receive and transmit enables, and interrupt control.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: core2pad
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Register-driven data to send to the pad.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: enable_rx_tx
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Direction control. 2'b00: Neither RX nor TX enabled. 2'b01: TX enabled. 2'b10: RX enabled. 2'b11: Both enabled

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: interface_enable
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Register Interface Enable. Setting this chooses register values to drive the PAD. This includes core2pad, enable_rx_tx, and pad2core

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: lsio_select
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Force the LSIO interface to be used from software, when no hardware LSIO request is present on this pad. interface_enable has higher priority over this bit. This ranking applies to this software force bit only: the hardware lsio_interface_select_i input outranks interface_enable. Use lsio_disable to gate both.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: interrupt_enable
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Interrupt Enable.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: lsio_disable
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When set, LSIO accesses will be blocked from the GPIO interface

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: interrupt_type
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Interrupt type - 0: active-high level, 1: active-low level, 2: rising edge, 3: falling edge

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: lsio_enable
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: LSIO hardware request status. Set while lsio_interface_select_i is asserted and lsio_disable is clear. Because the hardware LSIO request outranks interface_enable, a set value also means the LSIO plane is driving this pad's data and direction. This field does not reflect a software-forced selection via lsio_select, which ranks below the register interface - it reads 0 in that case even when LSIO drives the pad.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: pad2core
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: PAD2SOC Value

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: use_reg_core2pad
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Per-field register override. When set, core2pad is register-driven. OR'd with interface_enable.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: use_reg_tx
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Per-field register override. When set, the TX direction (output enable) is taken from enable_rx_tx[0]. OR'd with interface_enable.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: use_reg_rx
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Per-field register override. When set, the RX direction (input enable) is taken from enable_rx_tx[1]. OR'd with interface_enable.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: ACCESS_FILTER
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: GPIO Access Filter Register. WARNING: please read back this register to ensure the filter was written correctly. If you do not do so the filter may not update before your next transaction, causing unexpected behavior.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: write_filter_enable
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Write Filter Enable. When set, writes require an exact match between AXI AWPROT and awprot_requirement. When clear, writes are unfiltered. PROT does not identify the initiator. WARNING: please read back this register to ensure the filter was written correctly. If you do not do so the filter may not update before your next transaction, causing unexpected behavior.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: read_filter_enable
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Read Filter Enable. When set, reads require an exact match between AXI ARPROT and arprot_requirement. When clear, reads are unfiltered. PROT does not identify the initiator. WARNING: please read back this register to ensure the filter was written correctly. If you do not do so the filter may not update before your next transaction, causing unexpected behavior.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: awprot_requirement
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When write_filter_enable is set, only allow write accesses with this prot value WARNING: please read back this register to ensure the filter was written correctly. If you do not do so the filter may not update before your next transaction, causing unexpected behavior.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: arprot_requirement
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When read_filter_enable is set, only allow read accesses with this prot value WARNING: please read back this register to ensure the filter was written correctly. If you do not do so the filter may not update before your next transaction, causing unexpected behavior.

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: smc_avsbus_controller
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: Command, readback, status, and interrupt registers for the AVSBus (V1.3.1) controller.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: AVS_CMD
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: The command+data to be transferred to the AVS bus

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CMD_DATA
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Write Cmd Data. Formats: [list] [*]Voltage (cmd_code 0x0): 16-bit unsigned int, 1LSB=1mV [*]Transition Rate (cmd_code 0x1): [list] [*]MSByte: Rise Rate, 8-bit unsigned int, 1LSB=1mV/us [*]LSByte: Fall Rate, 8-bit unsigned int, 1LSB=1mV/us [/list] [*]Reset Voltage (cmd_code 0x4): 16-bits, all zeroes [*]Power Mode (cmd_code 0x5): 3-bits, LSB aligned: [list] [*]0x0 - Maximum Efficiency [*]0x3 - Maximum Power [*]0x4-0x7 - Manufacturer-specific [/list] [*]AVSBus Status (cmd_code 0xe): 16-bits, encoded per AVS Spec [*]AVSBus Version (cmd_code 0xf): 4 bits encoded per AVS Spec, LSB-aligned [*]For read cmd_code's, this is 0xffff [/list]

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RAIL_SEL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Rail Select: 0x0 - Rail 0 0x1 - Rail 1 0xf - Broadcast

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CMD_CODE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Command Code (For cmd_group=0. For cmd_group=1, this is manufacturer-specific): [list] [*]0x0 - Target Rail Voltage Read/Write [*]0x1 - Vout Transition Rate Read/Write [*]0x2 - Rail Current Read [*]0x3 - Temperature Read [*]0x4 - Force Voltage Reset (Requires wr_cmd_data=0x0) [*]0x5 - Power Mode Read/Write [*]0xe - AVSBus Status Read/Write [*]0xf - AVSBus Version Read [/list]

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CMD_GRP
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Command group: Set to 1 for manufacturer-specific Command Code (cmd_code), otherwise 0

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: R_OR_W
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Read or write type: [list] [*]0x0 - Commit Write [*]0x1 - Hold Write [*]0x2 - Read [/list]

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: AVS_READBACK
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Response data from AVS slave device (updated in response to both AVS read and write commands). Reading this register causes the AVS response readback fifo pointer to advance.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CRC
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: The CRC-3 code received from slave

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CMD_DATA
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Read Cmd Data. Format depends on cmd_code in previous master subframe:[list] [*]Voltage (cmd_code 0x0): 16-bit unsigned int, 1LSB=1mV [*]Transition Rate (cmd_code 0x1): [list] [*]MSByte: Rise Rate, 8-bit unsigned int, 1LSB=1mV/us [*]LSByte: Fall Rate, 8-bit unsigned int, 1LSB=1mV/us [/list] [*]Current (cmd_mode 0x2): 16-bit unsigned, 1LSB=10mA [*]Temperature (cmd_code 0x3): 16-bit signed, 1LSB=0.1degC [*]Power Mode (cmd_code 0x5): 3-bits, LSB aligned: [list] [*]0x0 - Maximum Efficiency [*]0x3 - Maximum Power [*]0x4-0x7 - Manufacturer-specific [/list] [*]AVSBus Status (cmd_code 0xe): 16-bits, encoded per AVS Spec [*]AVSBus Version (cmd_code 0xf): 4 bits encoded per AVS Spec, LSB-aligned [*]If master issued a write (rw!=0x2) in previous master subframe, this field is 0xffff [/list]

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: STATUS_RESPONSE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: 5-bit field indicating general condition of the slave, per AVS spec StatusReponse field: [list] [*]bit 4: VDone - AND of all VDone bits of active rails [*]bit 3: StatusAlert - Indicates potential status issue, requiring AVSBus Status read cmd for details [*]bit 2: AVS_Control - 1 if ABSBus is controlling at least 1 device output, 0 otherwise. [*]bit 1: MfrSpcfc_Stts1 - Manufacturer-specific [*]bit 0: MfrSpcfc_Stts2 - Manufacturer-specific [/list]

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CONST0
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Always 0

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SLAVE_ACK
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates whether command executed or not - codes 0x1 and 0x2 trigger automatic retries by hardware: [list] [*]0x0: Action Performed [*]0x1: Good CRC received but resource unavailable - hardware will retry [*]0x2: Bad CRC received - hardware will retry [*]0x3: Good CRC received but bad data, data type or selector - no hardware retry [/list]

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: AVS_DEBUG_READBACK
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: This register mirrors the AVS_READBACK register, but reading it does NOT affect the AVS readback fifo pointer. Provided for debug purposes.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: AVS_SLAVE_SUBFRAME
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: The current top-of-fifo AVS slave response sub-frame in the readback fifo

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: AVS_LATEST_SLAVE_SUBFRAME
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: This register contains the most recently received subframe from the AVS slave, bypassing the AVS readback fifo. It is provided so that APB can see the current slave StatusResponse and SlaveAck settings in a timely fashion, since the status data from the next entry in the readback fifo might have considerable latency relative to when it was initially received from the AVS Slave.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: AVS_SLAVE_SUBFRAME
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: The most recently received AVS slave response sub-frame

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: AVS_NORMAL_STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Various Status bits indicating normal operating conditions for APB2AVS bridge block. These all have corresponding maskable bits in the AVS_INTERRUPT register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TOTAL_RETRIES
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Total number of retries attempted by the AVS Master

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: AVS_MASTER_IS_RETRYING
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Master is currently in the middle of retrying a failed command

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CMD_FIFO_EMPTY
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates AVS_CMD fifo is empty

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CMD_FIFO_FULL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates AVS_CMD fifo is full - any additional APB writes to AVS_CMD will be dropped until the AVS bus can accept the next command, thus freeing space in the cmd fifo

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: READBACK_FIFO_FULL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates read-back fifo is full - no new AVS commands will be launched until space is freed by an AVS_READBACK access

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: READBACK_HAS_DATA
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates AVS_READBACK register has data ready to read on APB

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: AVS_BUS_IS_IDLE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that neither AVS master nor slave is currently driving a transaction on the AVS bus

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: AVS_SLAVE_IS_IN_RESYNC
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that the AVS master is issuing a slave resync operation (34 clock cycles of holding mdata high)

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: AVS_SLAVE_STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Contains the most recent status feedback from the AVS slave device

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: AVS_SLAVE_STATUS_RESPONSE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: The 5-bit Slave StatusResponse of the most recent slave subframe received, indicating the general condition of the slave, per AVS spec StatusReponse field: [list] [*]bit 4: VDone - AND of all VDone bits of active rails [*]bit 3: StatusAlert - Indicates potential status issue, requiring AVSBus Status read cmd for details [*]bit 2: AVS_Control - 1 if ABSBus is controlling at least 1 device output, 0 otherwise. [*]bit 1: MfrSpcfc_Stts1 - Manufacturer-specific [*]bit 0: MfrSpcfc_Stts2 - Manufacturer-specific [/list]

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: AVS_SLAVE_ACK
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: The SlaveAck bits of the most recent slave subframe received: [list] [*]00: Action Performed [*]01:Good CRC received by resource unavailable. No action performed (triggers retry) [*]10: Bad CRC received (triggers retry) [*]11: Good CRC received bit bad data, data type, or selector. No action performed [/list]

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: AVS_FIFOS_STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Contains the number of occupied and vacant slots in the AVS master's command and readback FIFOs

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CMD_FIFO_OCCUPIED_SLOTS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Number of occupied slots in the command FIFO

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CMD_FIFO_VACANT_SLOTS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Number of vacant slots in the command FIFO

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: READBACK_FIFO_OCCUPIED_SLOTS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Number of occupied slots in the readback FIFO

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: READBACK_FIFO_VACANT_SLOTS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Number of vacant slots in the readback FIFO

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: AVS_INTERRUPT
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Interrupt register - A '1' indicates an interrupt has occurred for that bit. To clear the interrupt bit, write to the corresponding field in the AVS_INTERRUPT_CLEAR register.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: AVS_SLAVE_ISSUED_INTERRUPT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates the AVS slave has signaled an interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CMD_FIFO_FULL_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates AVS_CMD fifo is full - any additional APB writes to AVS_CMD will be dropped until the AVS bus can accept the next command, thus freeing space in the cmd fifo

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: READBACK_FIFO_FULL_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates read-back fifo is full - no new AVS commands will be launched until space is freed by an AVS_READBACK access

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: READBACK_HAS_DATA_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates AVS_READBACK register has data ready to read on APB

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SLAVE_UNRESPONSIVE_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates the AVS Slave device is not responding to command subframes from the Master

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: MAX_RETRIES_ATTEMPTED_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that the AVS Master failed to receive a non-failure acknowledgement from the Slave after a command was retried the maximum allowable number of times (as determined by AVS_CFG_0:max_retries)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CMD_FIFO_OVERFLOW_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that an APB write to AVS_CMD was attempted when the the command fifo was already full - the command is dropped

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: READBACK_UNDERFLOW_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that an APB read on the AVS_READBACK reg occurred when the readback fifo was empty (AVS_NORMAL_STATUS:readback_has_data=0)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: READBACK_OVERFLOW_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates that the response from AVS slave could not be written to readback FIFO due to it being full => response was dropped

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: AVS_INTERRUPT_MASK
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Interrupt mask register - Determines which AVS_INTERRUPT bits can trigger an interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DISABLE_AVS_SLAVE_ISSUED_INTERRUPT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Disable notification of AVS slave interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DISABLE_CMD_FIFO_FULL_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Disable cmd_fifo_full interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DISABLE_READBACK_FIFO_FULL_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Disable readback_fifo_full interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DISABLE_READBACK_HAS_DATA_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Disable readback_has_data interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DISABLE_SLAVE_UNRESPONSIVE_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Disable slave_unresponsive interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DISABLE_MAX_RETRIES_ATTEMPTED_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Disable max_retries_attempted interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DISABLE_CMD_FIFO_OVERFLOW_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Disable cmd_fifo_overflow interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DISABLE_READBACK_UNDERFLOW_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Disable readback_underflow interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DISABLE_READBACK_OVERFLOW_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Disable readback_overflow interrupt

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: AVS_INTERRUPT_CLEAR
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Write 1 to clear corresponding interrupt bit

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CLEAR_AVS_SLAVE_ISSUED_INTERRUPT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clear avs_slave_issued_interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CLEAR_CMD_FIFO_FULL_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clear cmd_fifo_full interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CLEAR_READBACK_FIFO_FULL_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clear readback_fifo_full interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CLEAR_READBACK_HAS_DATA_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clear readback_has_data interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CLEAR_SLAVE_UNRESPONSIVE_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clear slave_unresponsive interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CLEAR_MAX_RETRIES_ATTEMPTED_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clear max_retries_attempted interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CLEAR_CMD_FIFO_OVERFLOW_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clear cmd_fifo_overflow interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CLEAR_READBACK_UNDERFLOW_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clear readback_underflow interrupt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CLEAR_READBACK_OVERFLOW_INT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Clear readback_overflow interrupt

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: AVS_CFG_0
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Configuration register for APB2AVS bridge block

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RESYNC_INTERVAL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Max interval to issue slave resync operation on AVS bus, expressed in number of APB clock cycles. NOTE: there is a 3 cycle delay for the resync flag to be seen by the avs controller due to synchronization.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: MAX_RETRIES
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Maximum number of times to attempt a retry if an AVS command returns a fail status (either due to targeted resource being busy or CRC failure)

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: AVS_CFG_1
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Configuration register for APB2AVS bridge block

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: AVS_CLOCK_SELECT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Selects which clock to use for AVS Clock: [list] [*] 00: Use the APB clock directly as the AVS clock [*] 01: Use a divided version of APB clock as the AVS Clock. The clock divider settings are determined by AVS_CFG_1:clk_divider_value and AVS_CFG_1:clk_divider_duty_cycle_numerator [*] 10: Use the refclk clock directly as the AVS clock [*] 11: Use a divided version of refclk clock as the AVS Clock. The clock divider settings are determined by AVS_CFG_1:clk_divider_value and AVS_CFG_1:clk_divider_duty_cycle_numerator [/list]

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: STOP_AVS_CLOCK_ON_IDLE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When the AVS bus is idle, gate the avs_clock from running. Restart it when there are new commands to be run. The master will always first issue 34 slave-resync cycles when the clock first restarts.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FORCE_SLAVE_RESYNC_OPERATION
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Force master to issue a slave resync (34 clock cycles of holding the mdata signal high) at the next possible opportunity. NOTE: there is a 3 cycle delay for the resync flag to be seen by the avs controller due to synchronization.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TURN_OFF_ALL_PREMUX_CLOCKS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Gate off all clocks entering the AVS clock mux - do this before changing the mux selection or changing the clock divider settings, then turn back on afterwards

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CLK_DIVIDER_VALUE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Determines the divisor value used to generate the AVS clock (when avs_clock_select is set to select the divided APB clock or divided refclk clock). The duty cycle of the divided clock depends both on the clk_divider_value together with the clk_divider_duty_cycle_numerator value. A 50% duty cycle is only possible on even clk_divider_values with clk_divider_duty_cycle_numerator set to 128. This field requires a minimum value of 2 - for lower values, 2 will be assumed. This is set to 0 by default to trick the clock divider into maintaining the HW-default settings (divider=0x4) by matching the FF default in the resynced version of the signal.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CLK_DIVIDER_DUTY_CYCLE_NUMERATOR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Determines the desired duty cycle of the divided clock (when avs_clock_select is set to select the divided APB clock or refclk clock). This value will be divided by 256 to determine the high-pulse percentage of the divided clock period. Depending on the clk_divider_value, it may not be possible to precisely achieve the desired duty cycle - in that case, the closest possible fit is used. If this is set to 0, a value of 1 will be assumed. This is set to 0 by default to trick the clock divider into maintaining the HW-default settings (numerator=0x80) by matching the FF default in the resynced version of the signal.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: AVS_CONFIG
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: AVS Configuration Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: AVS_GPIO_ENABLE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable AVSBus connection to GPIOs. The effective sets OE of the GPIOs dedicated to avs_clock and avs_cdata to 1, sets IE of GPIO dedicated to avs_tdata to 1. By default, this is enabled as the AVSBus state machine immediately starts after reset deassertion.

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: smc_i2c_wrap
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: Wrapper address map instantiating the per-controller I2C register blocks and shared control.

ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:name: i2c
ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: Interrupt status, enable, and test registers for a single I2C controller and target.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: INTR_STATE
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Interrupt Status Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FMT_THRESHOLD
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode interrupt: remains asserted while the Controller TX FIFO level is less than `HOST_FIFO_CONFIG.FMT_THRESH`.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RX_THRESHOLD
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode interrupt: remains asserted while the Controller RX FIFO level is greater than `HOST_FIFO_CONFIG.RX_THRESH`.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ACQ_THRESHOLD
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode interrupt: remains asserted while the Target RX FIFO level is greater than `TARGET_FIFO_CONFIG.ACQ_THRESH`.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RX_OVERFLOW
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode interrupt: asserted when the Controller RX FIFO overflows. Write `1` to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CONTROLLER_HALT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode interrupt: remains asserted while this controller halts. The flags in the `CONTROLLER_EVENTS` register explain the reason(s) for the halting. Clearing the `CONTROLLER_EVENTS` flags clears this interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SCL_INTERFERENCE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode interrupt: asserted when SCL is unexpectedly pulled LOW by another controller. Write `1` to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SDA_INTERFERENCE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode interrupt: asserted when SDA is unexpectedly pulled LOW by another controller. Write `1` to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: STRETCH_TIMEOUT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode interrupt: asserted when the target stretches the clock longer than `TIMEOUT_CTRL.VAL` (valid only when `TIMEOUT_CTRL.MODE = 0`). Write `1` to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SDA_UNSTABLE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode interrupt: asserted when the target fails to keep SDA stable during a transmission. Write `1` to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CMD_COMPLETE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller/Target Mode interrupt: asserted when this/the controller finishes generating a STOP or repeated START. Write `1` to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TX_STRETCH
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode interrupt: remains asserted while this target is stretching the clock or has halted. The flags in the `TARGET_EVENTS` register explain the reason(s) for clock stretching/halting. Clearing the `TARGET_EVENTS` flags clears this interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TX_THRESHOLD
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode interrupt: remains asserted while the Target TX FIFO level is less than `TARGET_FIFO_CONFIG.TX_THRESH`.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ACQ_STRETCH
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode interrupt: remains asserted while the target is stretching the clock because 1) the Target RX FIFO is full or 2) the `TARGET_ACK_CTRL.NBYTES` count has reached `0` (only if `CTRL.ACK_CTRL_EN = 1`).

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: UNEXP_STOP
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode interrupt: asserted when the controller sends this target a STOP before this target NACKs. Write `1` to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: HOST_TIMEOUT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode interrupt: asserted when the controller stops generating the clock longer than `HOST_TIMEOUT_CTRL.VAL`. Write `1` to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SMBALERT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode interrupt: asserted when `smbalert_ni` is asserted. Write `1` to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CONTROLLER_TX_FIFO_ERROR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode interrupt: asserted when the Controller TX FIFO has a parity error. Write `1` to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CONTROLLER_RX_FIFO_ERROR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Controller Mode interrupt: asserted when the Controller RX FIFO has a parity error. Write `1` to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TARGET_TX_FIFO_ERROR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode interrupt: asserted when the Target TX FIFO has a parity error. Write `1` to clear.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TARGET_RX_FIFO_ERROR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Mode interrupt: asserted when the Target RX FIFO has a parity error. Write `1` to clear.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: INTR_ENABLE
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Interrupt Enable Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FMT_THRESHOLD
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enables the `FMT_THRESHOLD` interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RX_THRESHOLD
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enables the `RX_THRESHOLD` interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ACQ_THRESHOLD
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enables the `ACQ_THRESHOLD` interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RX_OVERFLOW
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enables the `RX_OVERFLOW` interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CONTROLLER_HALT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enables the `CONTROLLER_HALT` interrupt.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SCL_INTERFERENCE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enables the `SCL_INTERFERENCE` interrupt.
