ipxact:registerFile.ipxact:description: Per-core reset control and status, reset timing, chip configuration, mailbox, and boot-ROM stub registers for the SMC CPU cluster.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: core0_reset_n_n0_scan
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reset control for the CPU, active low.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: core1_reset_n_n0_scan
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reset control for the CPU, active low.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: core2_reset_n_n0_scan
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reset control for the CPU, active low.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: core3_reset_n_n0_scan
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reset control for the CPU, active low.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: core0_reset_pulse_start_n0_scan
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Writing a 1 to this register triggers a core reset pulse, the duration of which is set by CORE_RESET_PULSE_COUNT. This pulse is ANDed with core_reset_n[0] so a 0 in core_reset_n[0] will override the pulse.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: core1_reset_pulse_start_n0_scan
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Writing a 1 to this register triggers a core reset pulse, the duration of which is set by CORE_RESET_PULSE_COUNT. This pulse is ANDed with core_reset_n[1] so a 0 in core_reset_n[1] will override the pulse.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: core2_reset_pulse_start_n0_scan
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Writing a 1 to this register triggers a core reset pulse, the duration of which is set by CORE_RESET_PULSE_COUNT. This pulse is ANDed with core_reset_n[2] so a 0 in core_reset_n[2] will override the pulse.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: core3_reset_pulse_start_n0_scan
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Writing a 1 to this register triggers a core reset pulse, the duration of which is set by CORE_RESET_PULSE_COUNT. This pulse is ANDed with core_reset_n[3] so a 0 in core_reset_n[3] will override the pulse.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: uncore_reset_n_n0_scan
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Cluster Uncore Reset, active low. Writing this register will only reset the uncore portion in the chipyard cluster. WARNING: using this can cause any outstanding axi requests to and from the cluster to cause timeouts/exceptions.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: debug_reset_n_n0_scan
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Debug Module Reset, active low

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: pre_reset_count
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Core reset pulse count pre-reset. The duration of the pulse is the set value + 1.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: post_reset_count
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Core reset pulse count post-reset. The duration of the pulse is the set value + 1.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: core_resets_done
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Logic low while performing core reset, logic high otherwise.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: timeout_value
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Cycles (clk_smc) a software reset may stay pending (withheld, waiting for drain) before timeout. 0 = disabled, wait indefinitely.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: timeout_mode
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Timeout mode: 0 = give up and report error (stay withheld, do not apply); 1 = force the reset on timeout.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: reset_applied
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Live status: high while a requested software reset is applied at the cluster, either after drain completes or after a force-mode timeout.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: reset_timeout
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Status for the active software reset request: high after the request exceeds timeout_value and remains high until the request is deasserted. Set in both modes.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: rc
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reference counter for the CPU. Write once, then poll this register until the readback reflects the written value before writing again. The counter keeps advancing, so the readback is at or just above the written value rather than equal to it.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: data
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Cycle count value that 2nd stage watchdog timer timeout should occur at. Defaults to 16384 cycles

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: reset_cycle_count_0
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Reset current cycle count value in 2nd stage watchdog timer

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: reset_cycle_count_1

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: IBI_DATA
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
Data Read from IBI Data Buffer.
The IBI Port is mapped to the IBI Data Queue. IBI Data is always aligned to a 4-byte boundary and then put into the IBI Queue. If the incoming data is not aligned to a 4-byte boundary, then there will be extra (unused) bytes at the end of the transferred IBI data. This can be determined from the value of field DATA_LENGTH in the IBI Status Descriptor.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: AGENT_CAPS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
Agent capabilities:
* bit 0: Identification (DEVICE_ID structure)
* bit 1: Forced Recovery (From RESET)
* bit 2: Mgmt reset (From RESET)
* bit 3: Device Reset (From RESET)
* bit 4: Device status (DEVICE_STATUS)
* bit 5: Recovery memory access (INDIRECT_CTRL)
* bit 6: Local C-image support
* bit 7: Push C-image support
* bit 8: Interface isolation
* bit 9: Hardware status
* bit 10: Vendor command
* bit 11: Flashless boot (From RESET)
* bit 12: FIFO CMS support (INDIRECT_FIFO_CTRL)
* bits 13-15: Reserved

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: NUM_OF_CMS_REGIONS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: 0-255: The total number of component memory space (CMS) regions a device supports. This number includes any logging, code and vendor defined regions

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: MAX_RESP_TIME

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: HEARTBEAT_PERIOD
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: 0-255: Heartbeat period, 2^x microseconds (us), 0 indicates not supported

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DESC_TYPE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
Based on table 8 from [DMTF PLDM FM]:
* 0x00: PCI Vendor
* 0x1: IANA
* 0x2: UUID
* 0x3: PnP Vendor
* 0x4: ACPI Vendor
* 0x5: IANA Enterprise Type
* 0x6-0xFE: Reserved
* 0xFF: NVMe-MI

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: VENDOR_SPECIFIC_STR_LENGTH

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DEV_STATUS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
* 0x0: Status Pending (Recover Reason Code not populated)
* 0x1: Device healthy (Recover Reason Code not populated)
* 0x2: Device Error (“soft” error or other error state) - (Recover Reason Code not populated)
* 0x3: Recovery mode - ready to accept recovery image - (Recover Reason Code populated)
* 0x4: Recovery Pending (waiting for activation) - (Recover Reason Code populated)
* 0x5: Running Recovery Image ( Recover Reason Code not populated)
* 0x6-0xD: Reserved
* 0xE: Boot Failure (Recover Reason Code populated)
* 0xF: Fatal Error (Recover Reason Code not populated)
* 0x10-FF:Reserved

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: PROT_ERROR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
* 0x0: No Protocol Error
* 0x1: Unsupported/Write Command - command is not support or a write to a RO command
* 0x2: Unsupported Parameter
* 0x3: Length write error (length of write command is incorrect)
* 0x4: CRC Error (if supported)
* 0x5-0xFE: Reserved
* 0xFF: General Protocol Error - catch all unclassified errors

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: REC_REASON_CODE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
* 0x0: No Boot Failure detected (BFNF)
* 0x1: Generic hardware error (BFGHWE)
* 0x2: Generic hardware soft error (BFGSE) - soft error may be recoverable
* 0x3: Self-test failure (BFSTF) (e.g., RSA self test failure, FIPs self test failure,, etc.)
* 0x4: Corrupted/missing critical data (BFCD)
* 0x5: Missing/corrupt key manifest (BFKMMC)
* 0x6: Authentication Failure on key manifest (BFKMAF)
* 0x7: Anti-rollback failure on key manifest (BFKIAR)
* 0x8: Missing/corrupt boot loader (first mutable code) firmware image (BFFIMC)
* 0x9: Authentication failure on boot loader ( 1st mutable code) firmware image (BFFIAF)
* 0xA: Anti-rollback failure boot loader (1st mutable code) firmware image (BFFIAR)
* 0xB: Missing/corrupt main/management firmware image (BFMFMC)
* 0xC: Authentication Failure main/management firmware image (BFMFAF)
* 0xD: Anti-rollback Failure main/management firmware image (BFMFAR)
* 0xE: Missing/corrupt recovery firmware (BFRFMC)
* 0xF: Authentication Failure recovery firmware (BFRFAF)
* 0x10: Anti-rollback Failure on recovery firmware (BFRFAR)
* 0x11: Forced Recovery (FR)
* 0x12: Flashless/Streaming Boot (FSB)
* 0x13-0x7F: Reserved
* 0x80-0xFF: Vendor Unique Boot Failure Codes

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: HEARTBEAT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: 0-4095: Incrementing number (counter wraps)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: VENDOR_STATUS_LENGTH
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: 0-248: Length in bytes of just VENDOR_STATUS. Zero indicates no vendor status and zero additional bytes.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: DEVICE_RESET
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: For devices which support reset, this register will reset the device or management entity

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RESET_CTRL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
* 0x0: No reset
* 0x1: Reset Device (PCIe Fundamental Reset or equivalent. This is likely bus disruptive)
* 0x2: Reset Management. This reset will reset the management subsystem. If supported, this reset MUST not be bus disruptive (cause re-enumeration)
* 0x3-FF: Reserved

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FORCED_RECOVERY
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
* 0x0: No forced recovery
* 0x01-0xD: Reserved
* 0xE: Enter flashless boot mode on next platform reset
* 0xF: Enter recovery mode on next platform reset
* 0x10-FF: Reserved

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: IF_CTRL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
* 0x0: Disable Interface mastering
* 0x1: Enable Interface mastering

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CMS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: * 0-255: Selects a component memory space where the recovery image is. 0 is the default

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: REC_IMG_SEL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
* 0x0: No operation
* 0x1: Use Recovery Image from memory window (CMS)
* 0x2: Use Recovery Image stored on device (C-image)
* 0x3-FF: reserved

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ACTIVATE_REC_IMG
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
* 0x0: do not activate recovery image - after activation device will report this code.
* 0xF: Activate recovery image
* 0x10-FF-reserved

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DEV_REC_STATUS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
* 0x0: Not in recovery mode
* 0x1: Awaiting recovery image
* 0x2: Booting recovery image
* 0x3: Recovery successful
* 0xc: Recovery failed
* 0xd: Recovery image authentication error
* 0xe: Error entering Recovery mode (might be administratively disabled)
* 0xf: Invalid component address space

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TEMP_CRITICAL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Device temperature is critical (may need reset to clear)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SOFT_ERR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Hardware Soft Error (may need reset to clear)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: VENDOR_HW_STATUS
ipxact:field.ipxact:displayName: Vendor HW Status (bit mask active high)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CTEMP
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
Current temperatureof device in degrees Celsius: Compatible with NVMe-MI command code 0 offset 3.
* 0x00-0x7e: 0 to 126 C
* 0x7f: 127 C or higher
* 0x80: no temperature data, or data is older than 5 seconds
* 0x81: temperature sensor failure
* 0x82-0x83: reserved
* 0xc4: -60 C or lower
* 0xc5-0xff: -59 to -1 C (in two's complement)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: VENDOR_HW_STATUS_LEN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: 0-251: Length in bytes of Vendor Specific Hardware Status.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CMS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
This register selects a region within the device. Read/write access is through address spaces. Each space represents a FIFO. Component Memory Space (CMS):
* 0-255: Address region within a device.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RESET
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
Reset (Write 1 Clear):
* 0x0: idle
* 0x1: reset Write Index and Read Index to initial value.
* 0x2 to 0xFF: reserved

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: IMAGE_SIZE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Image Size: Size of the image to be loaded in 4B units

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: EMPTY
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: If set, FIFO is empty

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FULL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: If set, FIFO is full

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: REGION_TYPE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
Memory Region Type:
* 0b000: Code space for recovery. (write only)
* 0b001: Log uses the defined debug format (read only)
* 0b100: Vendor Defined Region (write only)
* 0b101: Vendor Defined Region (read only)
* 0b111: Unsupported Region (address space out of range)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: WRITE_INDEX
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Offset incremented for each access by the Recovery Agent in 4B units

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: READ_INDEX
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Offset incremented for each access by the device in 4B units

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FIFO_SIZE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Size of memory window specified in 4B units. Current implementation supports only a constant size of 64.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: MAX_TRANSFER_SIZE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
Max size of the data payload in each read/write to INDIRECT_FIFO_DATA in 4B units
Enforced to 256 bytes (64 DWORDs) by Caliptra Subsystem Recovery Sequence

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: INDIRECT_FIFO_DATA
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Indirect memory access to address space configured in INDIRECT_FIFO_CTRL at the Head Pointer offset.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CAP_ID
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Extended Capability ID

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CAP_LENGTH
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Capability Structure Length in DWORDs

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: HANDOFF_DEEP_SLEEP
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: If this field has a value of 1'b1, then the Secondary Controller Logic shall report a return from Deep Sleep state to the Active Controller. Writing 1'b1 to this bit is sticky. This field shall automatically clear to 1'b0 after accepting the Controller Role and transitioning to Active Controller mode.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CR_REQUEST_SEND
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Write of 1'b1 to this field shall instruct the Secondary Controller Logic to attempt to send a Controller Role Request to the I3C Bus.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: BAST_CCC_IBI_RING
ipxact:field.ipxact:displayName: Ring Bundle IBI Selector for Broadcast CCC Capture
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates which Ring Bundle will be used to capture Broadcast CCC data sent by the Active Controller. The Ring Bundle must be configured and enabled, and its IBI Ring Pair must also be initialized and ready to receive data.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TARGET_XACT_ENABLE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
Indicates whether Read-Type/Write-Type transaction servicing is enabled, via an I3C Target Transaction Interface to software (Section 6.17.3).
1'b0: DISABLED: not available
1'b1: ENABLED: available for software

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DAA_SETAASA_ENABLE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
Indicates SETAASA method is enabled.
1'b0: DISABLED: will not respond
1'b1: ENABLED: will respond

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DAA_SETDASA_ENABLE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
Indicates SETDASA method is enabled.
1'b0: DISABLED: will not respond
1'b1: ENABLED: will respond

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DAA_ENTDAA_ENABLE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
Indicates ENTDAA method is enabled.
1'b0: DISABLED: will not respond
1'b1: ENABLED: will respond

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RSTACT_DEFBYTE_02
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
Controls whether I3C Secondary Controller Logic supports RSTACT CCC with Defining Byte 0x02.
1'b0: NOT_SUPPORTED: Do not ACK Defining Byte 0x02
1'b1: HANDLE_INTR: Support Defining Byte 0x02

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: STBY_CR_ENABLE_INIT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
Enables or disables the Secondary Controller:
2'b00 - DISABLED: Secondary Controller is disabled.
2'b01 - ACM_INIT: Secondary Controller is enabled, but Host Controller initializes in Active Controller mode.
2'b10 - SCM_RUNNING: Secondary Controller operation is enabled, Host Controller initializes in Standby Controller mode.
2'b11 - SCM_HOT_JOIN: Secondary Controller operation is enabled, Host Controller conditionally becomes a Hot-Joining Device to receive its Dynamic Address before operating in Standby Controller mode.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: STATIC_ADDR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: This field contains the Host Controller Device’s Static Address.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: STATIC_ADDR_VALID
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
Indicates whether or not the value in the STATIC_ADDR field is valid.
1'b0: The Static Address field is not valid
1'b1: The Static Address field is valid

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DYNAMIC_ADDR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Contains the Host Controller Device’s Dynamic Address.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DYNAMIC_ADDR_VALID
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates whether or not the value in the DYNAMIC_ADDR field is valid. 1'b0: DYNAMIC_ADDR field is not valid 1'b1: DYNAMIC_ADDR field is valid

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TARGET_XACT_SUPPORT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
Defines whether an I3C Target Transaction Interface is supported.
1'b0: DISABLED: Not supported
1'b1: ENABLED: Supported via vendor-defined Extended Capability structure

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DAA_SETAASA_SUPPORT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
Defines whether Dynamic Address Assignment with SETAASA CCC (using Static Address) is supported.
1'b0: DISABLED: Not supported
1'b1: ENABLED: Supported

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DAA_SETDASA_SUPPORT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
Defines whether Dynamic Address Assignment with SETDASA CCC (using Static Address) is supported.
1'b0: DISABLED: Not supported
1'b1: ENABLED: Supported

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DAA_ENTDAA_SUPPORT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
Defines whether Dynamic Address Assignment with ENTDAA CCC is supported.
1'b0: DISABLED: Not supported
1'b1: ENABLED: Supported

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: PID_HI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
High part of the 48-bit Target Device Provisioned ID.
This field is Read-Only while the STBY_CR_ENABLE_INIT field in register STBY_CR_CONTROL is not zero.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DCR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
Device Characteristics Register. Value represents an OCP Recovery Device.
This field is Read-Only while the STBY_CR_ENABLE_INIT field in register STBY_CR_CONTROL is not zero.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: BCR_VAR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
Bus Characteristics, Variable Part.
Reset value is set to 5'b10000, because this device:
- [bit4] is a Virtual Target
- [bit3] is not Offline Capable
- [bit2] does not apply due to bit1
- [bit1] is not capable of IBI requests
- [bit0] has no speed limitation
This field is Read-Only while the STBY_CR_ENABLE_INIT field in register STBY_CR_CONTROL is not zero.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: BCR_FIXED
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
Bus Characteristics, Fixed Part.
Reset value is set to 3'b001, because this device is an I3C Target, which supports extended capabilities.
This field is Read-Only while the STBY_CR_ENABLE_INIT field in register STBY_CR_CONTROL is not zero.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: PID_HI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
High part of the 48-bit Target Device Provisioned ID.
This field is Read-Only while the STBY_CR_ENABLE_INIT field in register STBY_CR_CONTROL is not zero.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DCR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
Device Characteristics Register. Value represents an OCP Recovery Device.
This field is Read-Only while the STBY_CR_ENABLE_INIT field in register STBY_CR_CONTROL is not zero.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: BCR_VAR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
Bus Characteristics, Variable Part.
Reset value is set to 5'b10110, because this device:
- [bit4] exposes a Virtual Target
- [bit3] is not Offline Capable
- [bit2] (always) uses the MDB in the IBI Payload
- [bit1] is capable of IBI requests
- [bit0] has no speed limitation
This field is Read-Only while the STBY_CR_ENABLE_INIT field in register STBY_CR_CONTROL is not zero.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: BCR_FIXED
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
Bus Characteristics, Fixed Part.
Reset value is set to 3'b001, because this device is an I3C Target, which supports extended capabilities
This field is Read-Only while the STBY_CR_ENABLE_INIT field in register STBY_CR_CONTROL is not zero.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: PID_LO
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
Low part of the 48-bit Target Device Provisioned ID.
This field is Read-Only while the STBY_CR_ENABLE_INIT field in register STBY_CR_CONTROL is not zero.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: STBY_CR_OP_RSTACT_STAT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: The Host Controller shall write 1'b1 to this field to indicate that the Secondary Controller received a RSTACT CCC from the Active Controller, followed by the Target Reset Pattern.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: STBY_CR_VIRTUAL_DEVICE_PID_LO
ipxact:register.ipxact:displayName: Standby Controller Virtual Device PID Low

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: PID_LO
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
Low part of the 48-bit Target Virtual Device Provisioned ID.
This field is Read-Only while the STBY_CR_ENABLE_INIT field in register STBY_CR_CONTROL is not zero.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: STBY_CR_INTR_SIGNAL_ENABLE
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: When set to 1'b1, and the corresponding interrupt status field is set in register STBY_CR_INTR_STATUS, the Host Controller shall assert an interrupt to the Host.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: STBY_CR_INTR_FORCE
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: For software testing, when set to 1'b1, forces the corresponding interrupt to be sent to the Host, if the corresponding fields are set in register STBY_CR_INTR_SIGNAL_ENABLE

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RST_ACTION
ipxact:field.ipxact:displayName: Defining Byte of the RSTACT CCC
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Contains the Defining Byte received with the last Direct SET CCC sent by the Active Controller. If not armed (START or RSTACT with unsupported defining byte) set to spec default 0x1.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RESET_TIME_PERIPHERAL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: For Direct GET CCC, this field is returned for Defining Byte 0x81.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RESET_TIME_TARGET
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: For Direct GET CCC, this field is returned for Defining Byte 0x82.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RESET_DYNAMIC_ADDR
ipxact:field.ipxact:displayName: Reset Dynamic Address after Target Reset
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: If set to 1'b1, then the Secondary Controller Logic must clear its Dynamic Address in register STBY_CR_DEVICE_ADDR after receiving a Target Reset Pattern that followed a Broadcast or Direct SET RSTACT CCC sent to the Dynamic Address, with Defining Byte 0x01 or 0x02. Requires support for Dynamic Address Assignment with at least one supported method, such as the ENTDAA CCC, with field DAA_ENTDAA_ENABLE set to 1'b1 in register STBY_CR_CONTROL. If field ACR_FSM_OP_SELECT in register STBY_CR_CONTROL is set to 1'b1, then this field shall be cleared (i.e., readiness to accept the Controller Role shall be revoked) with this Target Reset Pattern.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: VIRT_STATIC_ADDR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: This field contains the Host Controller Device’s Static Address.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: VIRT_STATIC_ADDR_VALID
ipxact:field.ipxact:displayName: Virtual Device Static Address is Valid
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
Indicates whether or not the value in the VIRT_STATIC_ADDR field is valid.
1'b0: The Virtual Device Static Address field is not valid
1'b1: The Virtual Device Static Address field is valid

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: VIRT_DYNAMIC_ADDR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Contains the Controller Virtual Device’s Dynamic Address.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: VIRT_DYNAMIC_ADDR_VALID
ipxact:field.ipxact:displayName: Virtual Device Dynamic Address is Valid
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Indicates whether or not the value in the VIRT_DYNAMIC_ADDR field is valid. 1'b0: VIRT_DYNAMIC_ADDR field is not valid 1'b1: VIRT_DYNAMIC_ADDR field is valid

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: MWL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: This field contains the maximum write length (MWL) (read-only)

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: STBY_CR_MRL
ipxact:register.ipxact:displayName: Standby Controller Maximum Read Length and IBI Payload Size (read-only)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: MRL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: This field contains the maximum read length (MRL) (read-only)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: IBIL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: This field contains the IBI payload size (IBIL) (read-only)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CAP_ID
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Extended Capability ID

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CAP_LENGTH
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Capability Structure Length in DWORDs

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: CONTROL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Control Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: HJ_EN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
Enable Hot-Join capability.
Values:
0x0 - Device is allowed to attempt Hot-Join.
0x1 - Device is not allowed to attempt Hot-Join.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CRR_EN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
Enable Controller Role Request.
Values:
0x0 - Device is allowed to perform Controller Role Request.
0x1 - Device is not allowed to perform Controller Role Request.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: IBI_EN
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
Enable the IBI queue servicing.
Values:
0x0 - Device will not service the IBI queue.
0x1 - Device will send IBI requests onto the bus, if possible.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: IBI_RETRY_NUM
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
Number of times the Target Device will try to request an IBI before giving up.
Values:
0x0 - Device will never retry.
0x1-0x6 - Device will retry this many times.
0x7 - Device will retry indefinitely until the Active Controller sets DISINT bit in the DISEC command.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Status Register

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: PROTOCOL_ERROR
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
Protocol error occurred in the past. This field can only be reset by the Controller, if it issues the GETSTATUS CCC.
Values:
0 - no error occurred
1 - generic protocol error occurred in the past. It will be set until reception of the next GETSTATUS command.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: LAST_IBI_STATUS
ipxact:field.ipxact:description:
Status of last IBI. Should be read after IBI_DONE interrupt.
Values:
000 - Success: IBI was transmitted and ACK'd by the Active Controller. 001 - FailureNack: Active Controller NACK'd the IBI before any data was sent. The device will retry sending the IBI as long as permitted by the retry counter. 010 - FailurePartialData: Active Controller NACK'd the IBI after data was partially sent. The remaining part of data in the IBI queue is considered corrupted and will be discarded. 011 - FailureRetry: IBI could not be serviced due to reached retry count. 100 - FailureArbitration:: IBI could not be serviced as arbitration was lost during the address header. The device will retry sending the IBI as long as permitted by the retry counter.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: RESET_CONTROL
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Reset Control for Queues and IBI Retry Counter

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: SOFT_RST
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Target Core Software Reset

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TX_DESC_RST
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: TTI TX Descriptor Queue Buffer Software Reset

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RX_DESC_RST
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: TTI RX Descriptor Queue Buffer Software Reset

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TX_DATA_RST
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: TTI TX Data Queue Buffer Software Reset. Also resets the tti_conv_Nto8 since first dword is immediately loaded into the converter and can't be cleared otherwise.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RX_DATA_RST
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: TTI RX Data Queue Buffer Software Reset

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: IBI_QUEUE_RST
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: TTI IBI Queue Buffer Software Reset

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: IBI_RETRY_CTR_RST
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: TTI IBI Retry Counter Software Reset

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: QUEUE_STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Dynamic queue full/empty status for debug and monitoring

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RX_DESC_QUEUE_FULL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: RX Descriptor Queue is full

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RX_DESC_QUEUE_EMPTY
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: RX Descriptor Queue is empty

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TX_DESC_QUEUE_FULL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: TX Descriptor Queue is full

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TX_DESC_QUEUE_EMPTY
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: TX Descriptor Queue is empty

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RX_DATA_QUEUE_FULL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: RX Data Queue is full

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RX_DATA_QUEUE_EMPTY
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: RX Data Queue is empty

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TX_DATA_QUEUE_FULL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: TX Data Queue is full

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TX_DATA_QUEUE_EMPTY
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: TX Data Queue is empty

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: IBI_QUEUE_FULL
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: IBI Queue is full

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: IBI_QUEUE_EMPTY
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: IBI Queue is empty

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: DESC_QUEUE_DEPTH
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Current number of entries in descriptor queues

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RX_DESC_QUEUE_DEPTH
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Number of entries in RX Descriptor Queue

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TX_DESC_QUEUE_DEPTH
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Number of entries in TX Descriptor Queue

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: DATA_QUEUE_DEPTH
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Current number of DWORD entries in data queues

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RX_DATA_QUEUE_DEPTH
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Number of DWORD entries in RX Data Queue

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: INTERRUPT_STATUS
ipxact:register.ipxact:description:
Interrupt Status.
How a bit is cleared depends on the bit:
- Auto-cleared by hardware on a specific access: RX_DESC_STAT, RX_DESC_THLD_STAT and RX_DATA_THLD_STAT clear when software reads the corresponding RX queue; IBI_DONE clears when software reads STATUS.LAST_IBI_STATUS. These bits are also write-1-to-clear, but the normal servicing access clears them without an explicit write here.
- Write-1-to-clear only (no hardware auto-clear): TX_DESC_COMPLETE, TX_DESC_STAT, TX_DESC_THLD_STAT, TX_DATA_THLD_STAT, IBI_THLD_STAT, and the not-implemented TRANSFER_ERR_STAT, TRANSFER_ABORT_STAT, TX_DESC_TIMEOUT, RX_DESC_TIMEOUT. Write 1 to the bit in this register to clear it.
- Read-only, hardware-driven level status that cannot be cleared by software: PENDING_IBI and PENDING_INTERRUPT track live conditions.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RX_DESC_STAT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: There is a pending Write Transaction. Software should read data from the RX Descriptor Queue and the RX Data Queue. Clear: auto-cleared by hardware when software reads the RX Descriptor Queue; writing 1 to this bit in INTERRUPT_STATUS also clears it.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TX_DESC_STAT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: There is a pending Read Transaction on the I3C Bus. Software should write data to the TX Descriptor Queue and the TX Data Queue. Clear: write 1 to this bit in INTERRUPT_STATUS (no hardware auto-clear — writing to the TX queues does not clear it).

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RX_DESC_TIMEOUT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Pending Write was NACK’ed, because the `RX_DESC_STAT` event was not handled in time. Clear: write 1 to this bit in INTERRUPT_STATUS (no hardware auto-clear).

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TX_DESC_TIMEOUT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Pending Read was NACK’ed, because the `TX_DESC_STAT` event was not handled in time. Clear: write 1 to this bit in INTERRUPT_STATUS (no hardware auto-clear).

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TX_DATA_THLD_STAT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: TTI TX Data Buffer Threshold Status, the Target Controller shall set this bit to 1 when the number of available entries in the TTI TX Data Queue is >= the value defined in `TTI_TX_DATA_THLD`. Clear: write 1 to this bit in INTERRUPT_STATUS (no hardware auto-clear).

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RX_DATA_THLD_STAT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: TTI RX Data Buffer Threshold Status, the Target Controller shall set this bit to 1 when the number of entries in the TTI RX Data Queue is >= the value defined in `TTI_RX_DATA_THLD`. Clear: auto-cleared by hardware when software reads the RX Data Queue; writing 1 to this bit in INTERRUPT_STATUS also clears it.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TX_DESC_THLD_STAT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: TTI TX Descriptor Buffer Threshold Status, the Target Controller shall set this bit to 1 when the number of available entries in the TTI TX Descriptor Queue is >= the value defined in `TTI_TX_DESC_THLD`. Clear: write 1 to this bit in INTERRUPT_STATUS (no hardware auto-clear).

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RX_DESC_THLD_STAT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: TTI RX Descriptor Buffer Threshold Status, the Target Controller shall set this bit to 1 when the number of available entries in the TTI RX Descriptor Queue is >= the value defined in `TTI_RX_DESC_THLD`. Clear: auto-cleared by hardware when software reads the RX Descriptor Queue; writing 1 to this bit in INTERRUPT_STATUS also clears it.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: IBI_THLD_STAT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: TTI IBI Buffer Threshold Status, the Target Controller shall set this bit to 1 when the number of available entries in the TTI IBI Queue is >= the value defined in `TTI_IBI_THLD`. Clear: write 1 to this bit in INTERRUPT_STATUS (no hardware auto-clear).

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: IBI_DONE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: IBI is done, check LAST_IBI_STATUS for result. Clear: auto-cleared by hardware when software reads STATUS.LAST_IBI_STATUS; writing 1 to this bit in INTERRUPT_STATUS also clears it.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: PENDING_INTERRUPT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Contains the interrupt number of any pending interrupt, or 0 if no interrupts are pending. This encoding allows for up to 15 numbered interrupts. If more than one interrupt is set, then the highest priority interrupt shall be returned. Read-only, hardware-driven level status: it cannot be cleared by software and updates as pending conditions change.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: PENDING_IBI
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: At least one IBI is pending. Read-only, hardware-driven level status: it tracks the live IBI-pending condition and cannot be cleared by software (clears automatically when no IBI is pending).

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TRANSFER_ABORT_STAT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Bus aborted transaction. Clear: write 1 to this bit in INTERRUPT_STATUS (no hardware auto-clear).

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TX_DESC_COMPLETE
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Read Transaction on the I3C Bus completed. Clear: write 1 to this bit in INTERRUPT_STATUS (no hardware auto-clear).

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TRANSFER_ERR_STAT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Bus error occurred. Clear: write 1 to this bit in INTERRUPT_STATUS (no hardware auto-clear).

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TX_DATA_THLD

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RX_DATA_THLD
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Minimum number of TTI RX Data queue entries of data received, in DWORDs, that will trigger the TTI RX Data interrupt. Interrupt triggers when `2^(N+1)` RX Buffer DWORD entries are received during the Read transfer.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TX_START_THLD
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Minimum number of available TTI TX Data queue entries, in DWORDs, that will trigger the TTI TX Data interrupt. Interrupt triggers when `2^(N+1)` TX Buffer DWORD entries are available.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: RX_START_THLD
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Minimum number of TTI RX Data queue entries of data received, in DWORDs, that will trigger the TTI RX Data interrupt. Interrupt triggers when `2^(N+1)` RX Buffer DWORD entries are received during the Read transfer.

ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable bit for the optional 60us HDR error recovery timer (I3C spec 5.1.10.1.9). When enabled, the Target can recover from TE0/TE1 errors if both SCL and SDA stay High for a period exceeding the configured threshold. Disabled on reset.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: T_HDR_TIMEOUT
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Timer threshold in clock cycles for the optional HDR error recovery (I3C spec 5.1.10.1.9). If both SCL and SDA stay High for this many clock cycles during a TE0/TE1 error-induced HDR mode, the Target exits HDR mode and returns to Idle. Configure based on System Clock to achieve 60us.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Signal1Select

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: CDbgEapStatus
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Register to indicate if an EAP was activated. There is one status bit per EAP in bits [15:0] (Node0Eap0..Node3Eap3, 4 EAPs per Node across 4 Nodes) and one write-to-clear bit per EAP in bits [47:32] (Node0Eap0W2C..Node3Eap3W2C); write the matching w2c bit to reset a status bit. The register is used by SW to know if an action was taken (ex: NMI ISR needs to know which of the EAP triggered the NMI)

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: CDbgClaCtrlStatus
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Ctrl/Status register to Enable EAP after EAP programming is complete, and read the current node.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: CurrentNode
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Read the current node.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: EnableEap
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Set Enable EAP to 1 after EAP programming is complete

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: EnableCla
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Set this bit to 1 to enable the CLA functional clock; clear it to 0 to gate that clock (save pwr). The CLA register block runs on a clock whose functional enable is tied high, so this bit can still be written while the functional clock is gated

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ClaChainLoopDelay
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Creates a window in which we don’t forward the incoming Xtrigger and Clock_Halt signal

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DisableGlobalClockHalt
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: If this bit is set, clock halt action is not applied to global clocks

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DisableLocalClockHalt
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: If this bit is set, clock halt action is not applied to local clocks

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Rsvd6216
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: reserved fields

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ClaLock
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: If this bit is set, then CLA is locked and the enable_cla is latched forever

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Dbmmode
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Mode selection, 0: DBM off, 1: Normal debug mode, 2: DBM ID output mode, 3: Toggle Mode

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Dbmid
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Unique DBM ID of the DBM instance

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Finegraintime
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Fine Grain Time Enable. If this bit is set, the fine grain time is enabled.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Muxselseg0
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Mux Select Bits for Lane 0. Split debug bus into 16 bit segments. Seg0 = debug bus [15:0], Seg1 = debug bus[31:16],.... If all bits are 0, Lane0 = Seg0, if bit[0] = 1, Lane0 = Seg4, if bit[1] =1, Lane0 = Seg5,...

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Muxselseg1
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Mux Select Bits for Lane 1. Split debug bus into 16 bit segments. Seg0 = debug bus [15:0], Seg1 = debug bus[31:16],.... If all bits are 0, Lane1= Seg1, if bit[0] = 1, Lane1 = Seg4, if bit[1] =1, Lane1 = Seg5,...

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Muxselseg2
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Mux Select Bits for Lane 2. Split debug bus into 16 bit segments. Seg0 = debug bus [15:0], Seg1 = debug bus[31:16],.... If all bits are 0, Lane2= Seg2, if bit[0] = 1, Lane2 = Seg4, if bit[1] =1, Lane2 = Seg5,...

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Muxselseg3
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Mux Select Bits for Lane 3. Split debug bus into 16 bit segments. Seg0 = debug bus [15:0], Seg1 = debug bus[31:16],.... If all bits are 0, Lane3= Seg3, if bit[0] = 1, Lane3 = Seg4, if bit[1] =1, Lane3 = Seg5,...

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Value

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: CDbgTransitionMaskLo
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: 3 registers to configure "transition event". This register is to select the signals of interest using a mask.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: CDbgTransitionFromValueLo
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: 3 registers to configure "transition event". The event is triggered on transition from Value A to Value B. This register specifies Value A.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: CDbgTransitionToValueLo
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: 3 registers to configure "transition event". The event is triggered on transition from Value A to Value B. This register specifies Value B.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: CDbgOnesCountMaskLo
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: 2 registers to configure "ones count" event. This register is to select the signals of interest using a mask.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: CDbgOnesCountValue
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: 2 registers to configure "ones count" event. Event triggered when the sum of the signals match the value specified in this register.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: CDbgAnyChangeLo
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Event triggered when a subset of debug signals change. The mask is used to select the subset of the debug signals.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: CDbgClaTimeMatch
ipxact:register.ipxact:description: This value is compared (greater than or equal to the programmed value) against the internal time register value of the core, and is used to generate a time match event for CLA. Needs to be non zero for the time match event signal to trigger. The event will only trigger an action if the EAP programming is done. Requires writing 0 to this register to stop the match event.

ipxact:register.ipxact:description: This value determines the time stretched pulse duration for the cross trigger. 8 bits for each of the two triggers.

ipxact:register.ipxact:description: 64-bit timestamp counter. Increments on time_tick. Can be written directly or loaded from timestamp_sync on xtrigger when resync is enabled.

ipxact:register.ipxact:name: CDbgClaTimestampSync

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Resync

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Trdstsyncmode
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When the field is set tp 2'b10, sent timestamp. All other vlaues not NA.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Trdstsyncmax
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When trDstSyncMode is set to 2'b10, timestamp will be sent for every 2^(trDstSyncMax + 4) Cluster clocks.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Trdstformat
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: bit[0]: XOR Enable, bit[1]: VLT Enable. Supported values : 2'b3 (XOR+VLT Compression), 2'b1 (XOR Compresion), 2'b0 (No Compression)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Trdstvendorframelength
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Specify frame length. Frame Length = trDstVendorFrameLength* 64 ; Frame Length should be a multiple of Bank Data Width.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Trdstvendorstreamlength
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Specify Stream length. A stream starts with "no compressed packet". Stream length specifies number of frames before a non-compressed packet is sent.Stream Length = 32* 2^(trDstVendorStreamLength + 1)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Trdsttimestampconfig
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: DST timestamp configuration. 0: timestamp input form external source (CoreTime). 1: timestamp from CLA timesync.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TraceSourceId
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Trace Source ID

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TraceFrameFillByte
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Use "Filler Packet" to align a stream of trace packets within a frame boundary.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FrameLenghtInBytes
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Use trDstImpl[trDstVendorFrameLength] for Frame Length programming. Register field ZBB-ed.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FrameModeEnable
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable Frame Mode (Frame Mode: Always pack "frame length" number of bytes for trace transmission). If flush to memory is stalled (due to silicon bug), we can have incomplete packets in memory. Frame Mode will help SW decoder to avoid reading incomplete trasnmitted packets. In Frame Mode, SW will get a memory pointer that is aligned to Frame Length. HW will ensure there are no incomplete packets incluced in the region pointed by memory pointer.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FrameClosureMode
